filter.template: {% set ns = namespace(cards=[]) %}{% for s in states.sensor if s.attributes.get('kind') == 'net_value_12m' and s.attributes.get('card_status') == 'active' and (s.attributes.get('years') or []) | count > 0 %}{% set done = s.attributes.get('years') | rejectattr('current') | list %}{% set y = done[0] if done else s.attributes.get('years')[0] %}{% set v = y.verdict %}{% set color = 'green' if v == 'earned its keep' else ('red' if v == 'did not earn its keep' else 'grey') %}{% set icon = 'mdi:check-circle-outline' if v == 'earned its keep' else ('mdi:close-circle-outline' if v == 'did not earn its keep' else 'mdi:help-circle-outline') %}{% set fee = ('$' ~ (y.fee | round(0) | int) ~ (' est.' if y.fee_source == 'estimate' else '')) if y.fee is not none else 'fee unknown' %}{% set back = y.captured + y.perks_value %}{% set net = y.net_with_perks %}{% set nettext = (('-' if net < 0 else '+') ~ '$' ~ (net | abs | round(0) | int)) if net is not none else '' %}{% set label = y.start[:7] ~ ' to ' ~ y.end[:7] ~ (' so far' if y.current else '') %}{% set ns.cards = ns.cards + [{'type': 'custom:mushroom-template-card', 'entity': s.entity_id, 'primary': s.attributes.get('card') ~ ' · ' ~ v, 'secondary': label ~ ': $' ~ (y.captured | round(0) | int) ~ ' credits' ~ (' + $' ~ (y.perks_value | round(0) | int) ~ ' perks' if y.perks_value else '') ~ ' against ' ~ fee ~ ' · net ' ~ nettext ~ ' · ' ~ y.months_covered ~ '/' ~ y.months ~ ' months', 'icon': icon, 'icon_color': color, 'multiline_secondary': true, 'tap_action': {'action': 'navigate', 'navigation_path': '/dashboard-cardperks/' ~ (s.attributes.get('card') | slugify | replace('_', '-'))}, 'sort': (0 if v == 'did not earn its keep' else (1 if v == 'earned its keep' else 2)) ~ s.attributes.get('card')}] %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.cards | sort(attribute='sort') }}

cards.content: What each card's welcome offer takes and by when, from the catalog and the card's open date. Mark a bonus used on its card page once the points post; the amounts here are the catalog's offer at verification time, and offers change.

filter.template: {% set ns = namespace(cards=[]) %}{% for s in states.sensor if s.attributes.get('kind') == 'benefit_status' and s.attributes.get('cadence') == 'one_time' and s.attributes.get('card_status') == 'active' %}{% set used = s.state == 'used' %}{% set spend = s.attributes.get('spend_required') %}{% set end = s.attributes.get('period_end') %}{% set days = s.attributes.get('days_left') %}{% set window = s.attributes.get('spend_window_days') %}{% if used %}{% set text = 'Earned' %}{% elif s.state == 'n_a' %}{% set text = 'Not applicable' %}{% elif end %}{% set text = 'Spend $' ~ (spend | round(0) | int if spend else '?') ~ ' by ' ~ end ~ ((' · ' ~ days ~ ' days left') if days is not none and days >= 0 else ' · window closed') %}{% else %}{% set text = 'Spend $' ~ (spend | round(0) | int if spend else '?') ~ (' within ' ~ window ~ ' days of opening' if window else '') ~ ' · set the open date to get a deadline' %}{% endif %}{% set ns.cards = ns.cards + [{'type': 'custom:mushroom-template-card', 'entity': s.entity_id, 'primary': s.attributes.get('card') ~ ' · ' ~ (s.attributes.get('bonus') or 'sign-up bonus'), 'secondary': text, 'icon': 'mdi:check-circle-outline' if used else ('mdi:minus-circle-outline' if s.state == 'n_a' else 'mdi:rocket-launch-outline'), 'icon_color': 'green' if used else ('grey' if s.state == 'n_a' else (s.attributes.get('color') or 'amber')), 'multiline_secondary': true, 'tap_action': {'action': 'navigate', 'navigation_path': '/dashboard-cardperks/' ~ (s.attributes.get('card') | slugify | replace('_', '-'))}, 'sort': (2 if used else (3 if s.state == 'n_a' else (0 if end else 1))) ~ (end or '') ~ s.attributes.get('card')}] %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.cards | sort(attribute='sort') }}

card_mod.style: .title { font-family: var(--ha-font-family-heading, Georgia, serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }

cards.content: Chase declines most applications from anyone who opened five or more personal cards in the past 24 months, at any issuer. Only cards with an open date count here, and business cards from most issuers do not report.

filter.template: {% set ns = namespace(cards=[]) %}{% for s in states.sensor if s.attributes.get('kind') == 'five_24' and s.state not in ['unknown', 'unavailable'] %}{% set n = s.state | int(0) %}{% set under = s.attributes.get('under_5_24') %}{% set accts = s.attributes.get('accounts') or [] %}{% set ns.cards = ns.cards + [{'type': 'custom:mushroom-template-card', 'entity': s.entity_id, 'primary': s.attributes.get('owner') ~ ': ' ~ n ~ ' of 5', 'secondary': (accts | join(', ')) if accts else 'No personal cards with an open date in the last 24 months', 'icon': 'mdi:counter', 'icon_color': 'green' if under else 'red', 'multiline_secondary': true, 'sort': s.attributes.get('owner')}] %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.cards | sort(attribute='sort') }}

cards.content: Type the dollars you captured. Status follows from the amount.

filter.template: {% set ns = namespace(rows=[]) %}{% for s in states.number if s.state not in ['unavailable', 'unknown'] and ((s.attributes.get('card_id') is not none and s.attributes.get('card_status') == 'active' and s.attributes.get('status') == 'unused' and (s.attributes.get('this_period') | float(0)) > 0) or (s.attributes.get('card_id') is not none and s.attributes.get('card_status') == 'active' and s.attributes.get('status') == 'partial' and (s.attributes.get('this_period') | float(0)) > 0)) %}{% set c = s.attributes.get('color') or 'grey' %}{% set ns.rows = ns.rows + [{'entity': s.entity_id, 'name': s.attributes.get('benefit') ~ ' used: ' ~ s.attributes.get('card'), 'tap_action': {'action': 'navigate', 'navigation_path': '/dashboard-cardperks/' ~ (s.attributes.get('card') | slugify | replace('_', '-'))}, 'card_mod': {'style': ':host { --paper-item-icon-color: var(--' ~ c ~ '-color); --state-icon-color: var(--' ~ c ~ '-color); }'}}] %}{% endfor %}{{ (ns.rows | sort(attribute='name'))[0:3] }}

title-card.primary: {% set ns = namespace(n=0) %}{% for s in states.number if s.state not in ['unavailable', 'unknown'] and ((s.attributes.get('card_id') is not none and s.attributes.get('card_status') == 'active' and s.attributes.get('status') == 'unused' and (s.attributes.get('this_period') | float(0)) > 0) or (s.attributes.get('card_id') is not none and s.attributes.get('card_status') == 'active' and s.attributes.get('status') == 'partial' and (s.attributes.get('this_period') | float(0)) > 0)) %}{% set ns.n = ns.n + 1 %}{% endfor %}{{ [ns.n - 3, 0] | max }} more credits

filter.template: {% set ns = namespace(rows=[]) %}{% for s in states.number if s.state not in ['unavailable', 'unknown'] and ((s.attributes.get('card_id') is not none and s.attributes.get('card_status') == 'active' and s.attributes.get('status') == 'unused' and (s.attributes.get('this_period') | float(0)) > 0) or (s.attributes.get('card_id') is not none and s.attributes.get('card_status') == 'active' and s.attributes.get('status') == 'partial' and (s.attributes.get('this_period') | float(0)) > 0)) %}{% set c = s.attributes.get('color') or 'grey' %}{% set ns.rows = ns.rows + [{'entity': s.entity_id, 'name': s.attributes.get('benefit') ~ ' used: ' ~ s.attributes.get('card'), 'tap_action': {'action': 'navigate', 'navigation_path': '/dashboard-cardperks/' ~ (s.attributes.get('card') | slugify | replace('_', '-'))}, 'card_mod': {'style': ':host { --paper-item-icon-color: var(--' ~ c ~ '-color); --state-icon-color: var(--' ~ c ~ '-color); }'}}] %}{% endfor %}{{ (ns.rows | sort(attribute='name'))[3:] }}

cards.heading: What perks are worth to you

card_mod.style: .title { font-family: var(--ha-font-family-heading, Georgia, serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }

cards.content: Lounge access and status carry no issuer amount, so the value is your call. A perk several cards share (Priority Pass) is one number for all cards, split equally between them.

filter.template: {% set ns = namespace(rows=[]) %}{% for s in states.number if s.state not in ['unavailable', 'unknown'] and ((s.attributes.get('card_id') is not none and s.attributes.get('card_status') == 'active' and s.attributes.get('kind') == 'perk_value') or (s.attributes.get('card_id') is not none and s.attributes.get('card_status') == 'active' and s.attributes.get('kind') == 'shared_value')) %}{% set c = s.attributes.get('color') or 'grey' %}{% set ns.rows = ns.rows + [{'entity': s.entity_id, 'name': s.attributes.get('benefit') ~ ' value: ' ~ s.attributes.get('card'), 'tap_action': {'action': 'navigate', 'navigation_path': '/dashboard-cardperks/' ~ (s.attributes.get('card') | slugify | replace('_', '-'))}, 'card_mod': {'style': ':host { --paper-item-icon-color: var(--' ~ c ~ '-color); --state-icon-color: var(--' ~ c ~ '-color); }'}}] %}{% endfor %}{{ (ns.rows | sort(attribute='name'))[0:3] }}

title-card.primary: {% set ns = namespace(n=0) %}{% for s in states.number if s.state not in ['unavailable', 'unknown'] and ((s.attributes.get('card_id') is not none and s.attributes.get('card_status') == 'active' and s.attributes.get('kind') == 'perk_value') or (s.attributes.get('card_id') is not none and s.attributes.get('card_status') == 'active' and s.attributes.get('kind') == 'shared_value')) %}{% set ns.n = ns.n + 1 %}{% endfor %}{{ [ns.n - 3, 0] | max }} more perks

filter.template: {% set ns = namespace(rows=[]) %}{% for s in states.number if s.state not in ['unavailable', 'unknown'] and ((s.attributes.get('card_id') is not none and s.attributes.get('card_status') == 'active' and s.attributes.get('kind') == 'perk_value') or (s.attributes.get('card_id') is not none and s.attributes.get('card_status') == 'active' and s.attributes.get('kind') == 'shared_value')) %}{% set c = s.attributes.get('color') or 'grey' %}{% set ns.rows = ns.rows + [{'entity': s.entity_id, 'name': s.attributes.get('benefit') ~ ' value: ' ~ s.attributes.get('card'), 'tap_action': {'action': 'navigate', 'navigation_path': '/dashboard-cardperks/' ~ (s.attributes.get('card') | slugify | replace('_', '-'))}, 'card_mod': {'style': ':host { --paper-item-icon-color: var(--' ~ c ~ '-color); --state-icon-color: var(--' ~ c ~ '-color); }'}}] %}{% endfor %}{{ (ns.rows | sort(attribute='name'))[3:] }}

cards.content: Drop an export in config/cardperks/statements/ and it is imported by itself. A month with no statement is unknown, not proof a credit went unused.

filter.template: {% set ns = namespace(cards=[]) %}{% for s in states.binary_sensor if s.state not in ['unavailable', 'unknown'] and ((s.attributes.get('card_id') is not none and s.attributes.get('kind') == 'statement_due' and s.attributes.get('card_status') == 'active' and s.state == 'on')) %}{% set ns.cards = ns.cards + [{'type': 'custom:mushroom-template-card', 'entity': s.entity_id, 'primary': '{{ state_attr(entity, "card") }}', 'secondary': 'Newest statement covers {{ state_attr(entity, "last_statement_month") }} · {{ state_attr(entity, "months_behind") }} months behind', 'icon': 'mdi:file-document-alert-outline', 'icon_color': '{{ state_attr(entity, "color") or "grey" }}', 'multiline_secondary': true, 'tap_action': {'action': 'navigate', 'navigation_path': '/dashboard-cardperks/' ~ (s.attributes.get('card') | slugify | replace('_', '-'))}, 'sort': (s.attributes.get('months_behind') | float(0))}] %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.cards | sort(attribute='sort', reverse=true) }}

{% set ns = namespace(cards=[]) %}{% for s in states.sensor if s.state not in ['unavailable', 'unknown'] and ((s.attributes.get('card_id') is not none and s.attributes.get('kind') == 'coverage_12m' and s.attributes.get('card_status') == 'active')) %}{% set ns.cards = ns.cards + [{'type': 'custom:mushroom-template-card', 'entity': s.entity_id, 'primary': '{{ state_attr(entity, "card") }}', 'secondary': '{{ states(entity) }}/12 months · {{ (state_attr(entity, "statements_imported") or 0) }} files{% set m = state_attr(entity, "missing") or [] %}{% if m %} · missing {{ m[:3] | join(", ") }}{% if m | count > 3 %} +{{ m | count - 3 }}{% endif %}{% endif %}', 'icon': 'mdi:file-document-check-outline', 'icon_color': '{{ state_attr(entity, "color") or "grey" }}', 'multiline_secondary': true, 'tap_action': {'action': 'navigate', 'navigation_path': '/dashboard-cardperks/' ~ (s.attributes.get('card') | slugify | replace('_', '-'))}, 'sort': (s.state | string)}] %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.cards | sort(attribute='sort', reverse=false) }}

card_mod.style: .title { font-family: var(--ha-font-family-heading, Georgia, serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }

cards.content: One membership, several cards. Each of these is one number for the household, split equally between the cards that carry it. A shared perk only one of your cards carries is listed under that card instead.

filter.template: {% set ns = namespace(cards=[]) %}{% for s in states.number if s.attributes.get('kind') == 'shared_value' and (s.attributes.get('card_ids') or []) | count > 1 %}{% set ns.cards = ns.cards + [{'type': 'custom:mushroom-template-card', 'entity': s.entity_id, 'primary': '$' ~ (s.state | float(0) | round(0) | int) ~ ' · ' ~ s.attributes.get('benefit'), 'secondary': '$' ~ ((s.attributes.get('per_card') or 0) | round(0) | int) ~ ' each on ' ~ (s.attributes.get('cards') | count) ~ ' cards: ' ~ (s.attributes.get('cards') | join(', ')), 'icon': 'mdi:tag-multiple-outline', 'icon_color': 'amber', 'multiline_secondary': true, 'sort': -(s.state | float(0))}] %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.cards | sort(attribute='sort') }}

card_mod.style: .title { font-family: var(--ha-font-family-heading, Georgia, serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }

cards.content: Status a card gives you appears by itself and renews with the card. Status you earned outright is added under Settings, CardPerks, Add elite status.

filter.template: {% set ns = namespace(cards=[]) %}{% for s in states.sensor if s.state not in ['unavailable', 'unknown'] and ((s.attributes.get('card_id') is not none and s.attributes.get('kind') == 'status')) %}{% set ns.cards = ns.cards + [{'type': 'custom:mushroom-template-card', 'entity': s.entity_id, 'primary': '{{ states(entity) }} · {{ state_attr(entity, "program") }}', 'secondary': '{{ state_attr(entity, "owner") }} · via {{ state_attr(entity, "source") }}{% if state_attr(entity, "valid_through") %} · through {{ state_attr(entity, "valid_through") }} · {{ state_attr(entity, "days_left") }} days{% endif %}', 'icon': 'mdi:medal-outline', 'icon_color': '{{ state_attr(entity, "color") or "grey" }}', 'multiline_secondary': true, 'tap_action': {'action': 'navigate', 'navigation_path': '/dashboard-cardperks/' ~ (s.attributes.get('card') | slugify | replace('_', '-'))}, 'sort': (s.attributes.get('days_left') | float(0))}] %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.cards | sort(attribute='sort', reverse=false) }}
